level.title: Turkish A3
goals: Handle a short Turkish exchange about school and studies.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about hobbies and free time.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about travel basics.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about food and restaurants.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about friends and social life.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about weather and plans.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about shopping and money.
Handle a short Turkish exchange about daily routines and future plans.

examples.en: I'm going to revise tonight.
She's going to miss the lecture.
Are you going to finish the homework?

dialogue.en: Have you got an exam tomorrow?

dialogue.t: Evet, tarih. Dersten sonra tekrar edeceğim.
dialogue.en: Yes, history. I'll revise after class.
Shall we study in the library?
Yes. The notes deadline is today.
